task.title: Change a person
task.shortdesc: Correct a name, a date or a place on a person's page.

prereq.p: Open the person first. shows how.

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom of the page and choose .

stepresult.p: The page turns into a form, in one column on the left. With the tablet on its side, the family tree stays on the right. The form may open part of the way down, so scroll up to see the names. A round help button sits beside most boxes.

info.p: is a list. For a date, type the day and the year and choose the month from the list. A line under the date says how the app reads it, such as Reads as 17 March 1777.

step.cmd: Scroll to the bottom of the form. Choose to keep your changes, or to leave the form as it was.

info.p: If you go back with the back arrow after you started to change a box, a box asks Discard changes? Choose to leave, or Keep editing to go on.

result.p: Your changes are saved to the file as you go. The page shows the new words.
result.note: The button sits below . It removes the person. Check before you choose it.
